stages.label: Observations arrive
stages.narrative: Synthetic noisy observations arrive without exposing the hidden scenario truth.

stages.label: Orbit and covariance fit
stages.narrative: Residuals and the uncertainty ensemble change as follow-up observations are incorporated.

stages.label: Policy decision
stages.narrative: The selected threshold and observation budget determine whether and how intervention proceeds.

stages.label: Encounter screened
stages.narrative: Baseline and intervention clone ensembles propagate to the modeled encounter and settle.

seeds.label: Short-arc follow-up
seeds.description: A synthetic short arc compares fixed cadence with information-gain follow-up.

seeds.label: Late precision observation
seeds.description: One later synthetic high-precision observation changes the modeled orbit distribution.

seeds.label: Encounter-plane sensitivity
seeds.description: A synthetic close-approach geometry examines covariance-targeted intervention sensitivity.

seeds.label: Launch reliability
seeds.description: Identical orbit clones compare uncertain kinetic execution with reconnaissance-first policy.

seeds.label: False-alarm calibration
seeds.description: A nonimpacting hidden synthetic orbit tests whether follow-up prevents unnecessary intervention.
